note: Second draft. Entries marked prior:true were already cited in WMT A3 before this index existed. Entries marked author_corrected:true were reassigned by the author after the first pass; treat those placements as settled. Confidence is the drafter's, not the author's — every medium and low entry is a question, not a claim.

entries.pericope: Trials produce steadfastness
entries.connection: Endurance is described as a process with a finished state, not a mood. This is the same claim the Discipline of Gradualism makes: that formation has a shape and a duration, and that shortening it is not available.

entries.pericope: Ask for wisdom; the double-minded man
entries.connection: Wisdom is asked for rather than achieved, which is the entrance requirement Proverbs 1:7 sets and C02 builds on. Double-mindedness names the divided interior that C07 treats as the obstacle to clear sight.
entries.review: PR04 removed at review — confident petition, not the limits of knowing.

entries.pericope: The lowly brother and the rich man
entries.connection: Status is inverted and then dissolved — the rich man fades mid-pursuit. Grounds Holy Detachment and sits directly under Deferential Seating.
entries.review: PR25 removed at review — status reversal stated as fact, not a practice.

entries.pericope: Blessed is the one who endures trial
entries.connection: The one who has stood the test receives the crown — endurance through failure rather than avoidance of it. Pairs with the Failure Recovery Protocol.
entries.review: PR11 removed at review — endurance under trial, not recovery after failure.

entries.pericope: The anatomy of temptation: desire, sin, death
entries.connection: Already the stated biblical basis for Interior Diagnosis. The conception-pregnancy-birth sequence is what makes tracing a symptom back to its root possible at all.

entries.pericope: Every good gift is from above; the Father of lights
entries.connection: No variation or shadow of turning — the constancy of the source, against which the Temple of Light material sets human inconstancy.

entries.pericope: Quick to hear, slow to speak, slow to anger
entries.connection: The most compressed statement of Listening as Mercy in Scripture, and the ordering matters — hearing first, speech second, anger last and slowest. Absorbing the Blow lives in that third clause.

entries.pericope: Doers and hearers; the mirror and the man who forgets
entries.connection: The direct scriptural mandate for the Moral Audit, and the source of C04's title. The forgetting is the whole problem: self-knowledge that does not survive walking away from the glass.

entries.pericope: Bridling the tongue; pure religion
entries.connection: Welds interior and exterior work in one sentence — visiting orphans and widows, and keeping oneself unstained. Neither half is optional and neither substitutes for the other.

entries.pericope: Against partiality; the gold ring and the shabby clothing
entries.connection: Reading people by category rather than character, named as sin and staged as a scene. The most concrete anti-partiality passage in the New Testament, and the direct ground of Deferential Seating.

entries.pericope: The royal law; the whole law and one point
entries.connection: Love of neighbor named as the royal law, with the integrity of the law argued as a unity. Supports C01's claim that the moral order is a structure rather than a menu.

entries.pericope: Mercy triumphs over judgment
entries.connection: Where the Moral Audit ends, and the reason it is survivable. Also the hinge under Merciful Reintegration — judgment is not abolished, it is outranked.
entries.review: Questioned on audit and retained. PR29 is receiving the repentant back without lingering probation, while mercy triumphing over judgment states the principle beneath that act. The tag stands; the tension is recorded here rather than resolved by deletion, so a later reader can weigh it against the passage.

entries.pericope: Faith without works is dead
entries.connection: The go-in-peace-be-warmed rebuke is the test C12 applies: fruit as evidence rather than sentiment. Also the passage the altar-not-ladder framing has to answer, and does.

entries.pericope: Show me your faith apart from your works
entries.connection: Belief alone is credited to demons, which forecloses assent as a sufficient account of faith. Sharpens the proof test without adding to it.

entries.pericope: Abraham and Rahab; faith completed by works
entries.connection: Faith working with works and completed by them — the grammar the grace-faith-works formulation in WMT depends on. Rahab's inclusion also refuses to make the principle respectable.

entries.pericope: Not many should become teachers
entries.connection: A warning attached specifically to teaching, and to the heavier judgment that comes with it. It belongs wherever this road addresses those who would lead others through it.
entries.review: Split from 3:1-2 at review. The reviewer was right that verse 2 is about speech; the pericope boundary was doing the damage. Verse 1 keeps the teaching-office reading.

entries.pericope: Whoever does not stumble in word is a perfect man
entries.connection: Speech named as the measure of whether the whole body can be governed at all. The hinge into the tongue material, and the reason Watchfulness begins at the mouth.
entries.review: Split from 3:1-2 at review, following the reviewer's placement.

entries.pericope: The bit, the rudder, and the fire
entries.connection: Three images for the disproportion between a small thing and what it steers or destroys. The governing logic of Watchfulness: guard the small gate because of what comes through it.

entries.pericope: No one can tame the tongue
entries.connection: An explicit limit on self-mastery, placed immediately after instructions on speech. Guards Watchfulness against becoming a technique that promises what it cannot deliver.

entries.pericope: Blessing and cursing from the same mouth
entries.connection: Audits the divided source rather than the divided output — the spring, not the water. This is the Moral Audit applied to speech, and the reason the audit has to reach the interior.

entries.pericope: Wisdom shown in conduct; bitter jealousy and selfish ambition
entries.connection: Earthly wisdom identified by its fruit — disorder and every vile practice — which is the fruit test of C08 turned on wisdom itself. Names what the Architecture of Peace is built against.

entries.pericope: The wisdom from above
entries.connection: Pure, then peaceable, gentle, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality or hypocrisy — the sequence maps onto the three pillars with unusual precision. Load-bearing for the pillar architecture itself.

entries.pericope: Wars and fightings come from your passions
entries.connection: Conflict traced upstream to pleasures already at war inside the person, before any of it reaches another human being. The passage is diagnostic rather than relational: it describes what the watchman is posted to see.

entries.pericope: God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble
entries.connection: Grace described as conditional on posture rather than performance. Sits under the Hidden Life: the humble receive because they are positioned to, not because they earned it.
entries.review: PR13 retained after author review. The drafter argued these were a name-reading error and the reviewer marked all three sound; the author reversed the removal on reflection. The Hidden Life is read here as reaching the whole posture — the low place held without display, which is what grace is said to be given to — not only unsupervised work.

entries.pericope: Draw near to God and he will draw near to you
entries.connection: A reciprocal movement with the human step named first, then cleansing, then lament, then humbling. Verse 9 commands mourning outright, which makes this the clearest New Testament warrant for Sacred Lament; the sequence as a whole is a return.
entries.review: PR08 added at review — a real miss. PR11 kept against the reviewer's advice: submit, resist, draw near, cleanse, humble is a return protocol. PR03 declined — cleansing the hands is purification, not self-accusation.

entries.pericope: Do not speak against one another
entries.connection: Judging a neighbor recast as judging the law itself — an argument from standing rather than from kindness. Grounds Covering Weakness and the sequence discipline of Self-Accusation.
entries.review: Questioned on audit and retained. PR03 is looking at your own portion first in any friction, while this passage argues from the standing to judge at all. The tag stands; the tension is recorded here rather than resolved by deletion, so a later reader can weigh it against the passage.

entries.pericope: You are a mist; if the Lord wills
entries.connection: Planning without reference to contingency named as boasting. The Discipline of Unknowing applied to the future rather than to doctrine, which is where it bites hardest.

entries.pericope: The wages of the laborers cry out
entries.connection: The withheld wage from Deuteronomy, carried into the New Testament without softening. Direct continuity with C01's argument that the moral order registers economic conduct as a structural event.

entries.pericope: The farmer waits for the early and the late rain
entries.connection: Patience given an agricultural rather than a stoic shape — waiting that includes tending. One of the cleanest images available for the Discipline of Gradualism.

entries.pericope: Do not grumble against one another
entries.connection: Grumbling treated as a judicial act with the judge already at the door. Small-scale complaint given weight the Architecture of Peace assumes but does not always argue.
entries.review: PR17 removed on audit. PR17 is protecting someone from public embarrassment by absorbing the inconvenience oneself. This passage concerns complaint between members, which is a different act. The tag was assigned from the practice's name — the fourth instance of that error, and the one that exposed three more.

entries.pericope: The prophets and the steadfastness of Job
entries.connection: Job named as the model of endurance, which is how WMT already reads him in the Sacred Lament material. Confirms that lament and steadfastness are the same posture, not opposites.

entries.pericope: Let your yes be yes
entries.connection: Speech that requires no oath because it is already reliable. Parallels the Didache's instruction against the double tongue, which C05 draws on.

entries.pericope: Is anyone suffering? Let him pray
entries.connection: Every condition given a corresponding act, which is the logic of the Daily Anchors. Also locates healing in a gathered body rather than a private effort.

entries.pericope: Confess to one another and pray for one another
entries.connection: Mutual confession, not upward confession — healing located in the exchange itself. The communal form of what Self-Accusation does privately.

entries.pericope: Elijah was a man of like nature with ourselves
entries.connection: The explicit refusal to place the exemplar in a different category from the reader. Guards the whole seven-stage path against being read as a description of other people.

entries.pericope: Bringing back one who wanders
entries.connection: The letter closes by sending an ordinary member after someone who has wandered. Restoration is presented as a capacity of the enlarged heart, not as a final instruction appended to the road.

review_log.adjudication: 3 accepted in full, 1 accepted in part, 1 resolved by splitting the entry.
